name: Bitfocus Companion
hint: page/row/column of a button (1/0/5), optionally followed by down or up (1/0/5 down). A button does whatever its own actions say, so a cue is only as safe as the button. Change the department in the Rig tab if this one drives lighting or audio

rules.source: Companion's OSC control page (companion.free, v4.3) lists /location/<page>/<row>/<column>/down and /up
Companion's OSC control page (companion.free, v4.3) lists /location/<page>/<row>/<column>/press; the older /press/bank form is marked deprecated there
